blurb: Newbury Golf Center is a 27 acres of golfing paradise with Toptracer on every bay. It is the largest golf practice facility on the North Shore. Large enough to have no nets on both sides and the back of the range, this unique feature gives you the feel of a private country club. Offering a 300 plus yard driving range including 30 mats, 10 of the mats are in a covered building with radiant heat for year round use.
